title: LookNature
description: Data file content/look/nature.json: living nature (B2-5 R21, R24): how plants sway in the wind of the core, how snow lies, how grass and small plants are drawn in detail levels and how leaves fall. All of it is set as shader parameters or drawn near the camera; presentation only, not part of the hash. Values are placeholders.

NatureCover.description: The cloud cover over land the player has not seen yet (B2 R25): soft, light clouds, never black. How long newly seen land takes to clear is exploration.reveal_real_seconds of the world preset.

color.description: Palette colour id of the lit parts of the clouds.

shade_color.description: Palette colour id of the shaded parts of the clouds (light and friendly too, never dark).

puff_m.description: Size of one cloud billow on the ground (metres).

drift_m_per_s.description: How fast the cloud pattern drifts with the wind direction of this file (metres per real second; calm world: keep it slow). The cover itself never moves, only its pattern.

softness_cells.description: Blur of the edge between seen and unseen land (cells).

edge_softness.description: How gently the cloud thins out at its edge (share of the blurred edge, 0.01 hard .. 0.5 softest).

edge_puff.description: How far the billows push the edge in and out (0 = a smooth edge). Fully seen land always stays clear, unseen land always covered.

band.description: Share of the cloud pattern drawn in the shade colour (0..1).

band_softness.description: Softness of the step between shade and lit colour (0 = a hard comic step).

opacity.description: How much the cover hides (1 = everything; R25 wants unseen land hidden).

daylight_share.description: How far the clouds follow the tint of the day phase (water_light of content/look/daylight.json): 0 = always their own colour, 1 = fully tinted, so they do not glow at night.

sea_margin_cells.description: Open sea further than this from any land is never covered (cells): the cover is a bank over the island and its coast.

cells_per_frame.description: At most this many newly seen cells start clearing per frame; the rest wait their turn.

NatureWind.description: How the wind strength of the core (0..1) moves plants. The strength is smoothed in real time, so fast forward stays calm; a visual sways by its sway_m (content/look/objects.json).

direction_deg.description: Direction the wind blows to on the ground (degrees, 0 = +z, 90 = +x).

smooth_real_seconds.description: Time over which the shown wind follows the wind of the core (real seconds).

swings_per_second_calm.description: Swings per real second in still air (calm world: keep it slow).

swings_per_second_full.description: Swings per real second at full wind.

lean_share.description: Share of the bend that is a steady lean with the wind; the rest swings.

wave_length_m.description: Length of the wind wave running over the land (metres), so neighbours do not swing in step.

NatureSnow.description: How the snow cover of a season or weather (0..1) lies on ground and plants: patches on faces that look up.

color.description: Palette colour id of the snow.

edge.description: Softness of a patch edge (share of the patch noise, 0 = hard).

min_up.description: How far a face must look up to hold snow (y of its normal, 0..1).

NatureGrass.description: Grass and small plants (decorative plants of content/look/objects.json) in chunks with two detail levels; density and distance come from the quality level (content/look/quality.json).

types.description: Decor types drawn as grass; other decor is drawn with the objects.

chunk_m.description: Edge of a grass chunk (metres); the distance is measured to its centre.

near_share.description: Share of the grass distance of the quality level up to which every plant of its density is drawn.

far_density_share.description: Share of those plants still drawn beyond that, up to the grass distance.

switch_margin_m.description: Hysteresis of the switch between the levels (metres).

FallParticles.description: Small things falling near the camera (leaves; rain and snow in the weather look): drawn as particles in a box that follows the camera target, never part of the world state.

color.description: Palette colour id (content/look/palette.json); a seasonal colour shows its colour of the season.

box_m.description: Edge of the square around the camera target in which they appear (metres).

height_m.description: Height above the camera target at which they appear (metres).

drift_m_per_s.description: Sideways speed along the wind at full wind (metres per real second).

length_m.description: Length of one particle (metres): equal to size_m for a leaf or flake, longer for a rain streak.

spin_deg_per_s.description: Largest tumbling speed (degrees per real second); 0 keeps them aligned with their fall.
